_comment: OPTIONAL ESCAPE HATCH — normally leave this empty. Everything on the projects grid comes from GitHub: the description, topics (which become tags), the Website field (live link) and the social preview image. Layout is driven by topics too — add the topic 'featured' to make a repo the large flagship card, or 'portfolio-hide' to keep it off the site entirely. Only add an entry here if GitHub genuinely cannot express something. Keys per repo name: title, description, tags, details, featured, hidden, order, liveUrl.
